neighbours.label: The defined-document nouns of legal boilerplate, mainly capitalized ' Terms' and ' Agreement' ('these Terms', 'this Agreement') and 'personal data', not lowercase 'agreement' or 'terms' in everyday senses nor other legal wording.
fire: Any dispute arising under this Agreement shall be settled in London.

notes: Probes (fraction of max 20.12): 'stated in these Terms' 0.753, 'this Agreement shall survive' 0.681, 'Your personal data will be stored' 0.304. Lowercase everyday 'reached an agreement' 0.002, 'medical terms' 0.003, 'collected data' 0.004, 'contact information' 0.052. Layer 1, so treated as lexical; near misses keep the legal register but swap the noun.
